lab_title: Anatomy of the Human Heart: Structure and Circulatory Flow
top_level_objectives: Identify the four chambers, four valves, and major vessels of the human heart.
Explain the functional difference between the pulmonary and systemic circulation loops.
Correlate the myocardial thickness of the left ventricle with its physiological demand.
Describe the role of cardiac valves in ensuring unidirectional blood flow.

scenes.brief_purpose: Orient the student to the heart's external anatomy and spatial orientation.
key_visuals: A life-sized, translucent 3D model of a human heart hovering in front of the student.
Labels identifying the superior/inferior vena cava, aorta, and pulmonary arteries.
student_actions: Walk around the 3D heart to observe it from 360 degrees.
Tap on the major vessels to see their names and confirm their orientation.

scenes.brief_purpose: Explore the internal anatomy of the heart chambers.
key_visuals: A cross-section view of the heart revealing the four interior chambers.
Color-coded highlights (blue for deoxygenated, red for oxygenated) identifying the atria and ventricles.
student_actions: Drag a slider to gradually slice the heart model to view the interior.
Identify and label the right atrium, right ventricle, left atrium, and left ventricle by tapping them.

scenes.brief_purpose: Examine the heart valves and understand their function in preventing backflow.
key_visuals: Close-up views of the four valves (tricuspid, pulmonary, mitral, aortic).
Animated floating arrows indicating the one-way direction of blood flow.
student_actions: Use a magnifying glass tool to inspect the structure of each valve.
Trigger a 'playback' animation to see the valves open and close in sync with a simulated heartbeat.

scenes.brief_purpose: Analyze the structural difference between the left and right ventricles.
key_visuals: A side-by-side comparison of the right and left ventricular walls.
Text callouts highlighting myocardial thickness and function (lungs vs. systemic circulation).
student_actions: Use a measuring tool to compare the wall thickness of the left and right ventricles.
Drag a 'function' label onto each ventricle to correctly attribute their purpose.

scenes.brief_purpose: Trace the complete pulmonary and systemic circulation pathways.
key_visuals: A glowing, dynamic path animation showing blood flow through the heart.
A split-screen view showing the heart pumping relative to the lungs and the rest of the body.
student_actions: Follow the flow of a 'blood cell' particle as it moves through the heart.
Pause the animation at each valve/chamber to identify the state of the blood (oxygenated/deoxygenated).
